correctness.rationale: Relative to a fixed matching, a second matching exists in the retained graph exactly when there is an alternating cycle: a difference of matchings decomposes into such cycles, and toggling any one produces a second matching. Under contraction the allowed arc i->j is equivalent to i!=j and pi(j)!=i, so precisely the derangement inverse cycle cover is absent from the loopless complete bidirected graph. In a linear order exactly one candidate arc per unordered pair is forward. Each missing directed cycle forces at least one missing forward arc, attained by reversing its cyclic vertex order and concatenating the blocks. The remaining max acyclic size is binom(n,2)-c(pi), yielding the stated minimum feedback arc set. Insertion into a cycle of length at least two or addition of a transposition proves the recurrence; labelled cycles of lengths >=2 give the EGF. A cycle of size n-2(k-1) plus k-1 transpositions realizes the full spectrum, and standard cycle-type counts give both extremal multiplicities, including n=3. An independent bounded subset DP through n=7 (append j last, adding the existing arcs i->j for i in the previous subset) agreed; at n=7 the counts at 15,16,17 were 720,924,210. This checks the contraction count only on that range; the universal proof is analytic. Frozen code was inspected, not executed.
